Dialogs.Dialog: Looking at that fountain, doesn't it remind you of before we started dating？
Anegasaki
Yeah. We often ran into each other here on the way to and from work.
Actually, you went out of your way to come here, didn't you？
Yeah... but I like this place.
And I thought I might get to see you.
You were thinking that even back then？
Geez... you shouldn't ask something so obvious, okay？ It's embarrassing...
Ah, a cat.
Anegasaki
So cute～
Aww, I don't have anything to give you. Um... ah, a throat lozenge.
Want a throat lozenge？ Here, kitty kitty.
Meow, meow～
Ah, aww... it left.
...Do cats even eat throat lozenges？
Ugh～.
Anegasaki
Hey. When we walk like this, how do we look to other people？
What do you mean？
Do you think we look like boyfriend and girlfriend？ Or like a big sister and her little brother？
We are lovers, right？
Eh？ Ah, yeah...
Then isn't that good enough？
...Yeah, you're right. Sorry for saying something strange.
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, a lot of shrines have long staircases, huh？
Is that so？
Yeah. This one too... A stairway to heaven？
At a shrine？
As long as I'm walking beside you, anywhere is heaven.
(This is embarrassing...)
Come to think of it, what kind of god is enshrined here？
Anegasaki
Hmm, I've never really thought about it... maybe a god of matchmaking？
Really？
Because... you know？
...Did you pray here, by any chance？
Hehe. It's a se～cret.
Anegasaki
I love the view from here.
You can look down over the whole town.
It's barely changed since I was little. The view from here, too.
Huh... seen like this, it's a nice, quiet town.
Right？ Ah, can you see that？ Over there is...
Anegasaki
Ah, that was fun. This was the right pick.
Yeah. And I didn't expect much, either.
Hehe. If you expect too much, the shock is bigger when it's a dud.
Yeah. But today was a hit, I think.
Yes. A hit. A big hit.
How was it？
Anegasaki
Hmm, it was so-so. Ah, I'm going to buy a program, can you wait？
It was so-so, and you're buying one？
I make a point of buying one for every movie I see. Even really boring ones.
Even if it's boring？
When it's really boring, that alone makes it interesting.
Boring, yet interesting...
Anegasaki
Hmph.
Um... you didn't like it that much？
Nope. Bad actors, bad visuals, bad music, bad script. Just the worst.
R-Really...？
Ah... sorry. It just wasn't my taste... that kind of attitude isn't nice, is it.
Anegasaki
Hehe. Since we're here, want to have a match？
Sure, but... are you good at bowling, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Nope. Terrible.
Yet you want a match？
A kind boyfriend would naturally give me a handicap or two, right？
Got it. Then ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s score counts double.
Hehe. Give it your all, okay？ I want to see you being cool too.
Ah, a 5-10 split... that's a tough leave.
Anegasaki
Hehe. If you make this, I'll give you a reward.
All right！
Wow, amazing... you really knocked them down. Then, as promised...
That's it？
Hehe. Not satisfied？
(Well, that's nice in its own way.)
Anegasaki
Aww, missed again... why won't it roll straight？
Isn't it more amazing that it curves this much when you throw it normally？
But a gutter's a gutter. Boo boo.
...Could you be wasting an incredible talent in an incredible way？
Second throw, here I goooo.
Anegasaki
That was the first time in a while I really got to savor something like that.
Yeah. This kind of thing really is great.
That raw, hits-you-head-on feeling？ It's nice to feel it with your whole body, not just your eyes and ears.
Want to come again？
Hehe. If you ask me, sure.
Haah... I got a little too into it, I'm kind of tired.
Anegasaki
Hehe. I got excited too, for the first time in a while. Like... shivers？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you like this kind of thing, huh.
Well, yes... but just having you here makes my heart race...
Ah... no. Forget that！ Ah, geez...
Anegasaki
Hmm... hey, could it be you like... this kind of thing？
Um... were you not into it, maybe？
It's not that I can't stand it... but, hmm, I guess it's true I don't really like it？
I see...
Ah, no. I had fun today, okay？ It's just... you know？
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, let's sing this one next？
That's an old tokusatsu hero show song... can you sing it？
Of course. Ah... don't tell me you don't know it？
No way. Let's sing together.
Yeah. We're at karaoke, after all, we have to get hyped.
Anegasaki
Ah, I know this intro.
I put it on for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Here, the mic.
Whaa!? But this is a super mushy love song!?
That's why I want you to sing it. Look, it's starting.
Aww, geez... this is embarrassing...
Anegasaki
Here. I put in a song, so sing it, okay？
Me？
Yes. It's a song I love.
I see... got it. I'll sing it for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. With all my heart.
Ah... Somehow, I'm the one who feels embarrassed now.
Anegasaki
Wow...
Amazing... you can see pretty far.
It's even higher than the hill at the shrine. Look.
So this is our town...
Yes... thank you for coming to this town.
Anegasaki
Hey, look, look. When we get to the very top, doesn't it feel like only our gondola is floating？
Now that you say it... it's a strange feeling.
The other gondolas can't... see us, right？
Yeah, I don't think they can right now.
Hehe. No funny business, okay？
I-I won't.
You won't？
Well...
Hehe. That side of you is so cute...
Anegasaki
Huh... is this haunted house one of the well-made ones？
Aren't you scared？
Hehe. If I got scared at this level, I couldn't call myself a horror fan, right？
Eek...
...So you're not scared.
I-I was just startled, okay？ Yes. Just startled.
Anegasaki
Eek, so scaaary.
You're not scared at all, are you？
No. It's true I'm a little scared, okay？ That's why I want something to hold on to.
That's my arm, though...
Hehe. I always longed to do this.
I kind of get that.
So I was set on doing it once I got a boyfriend. And of course, from now on too... okay？
Anegasaki
Hey. Hey！
W-What is it？
My hand... will you hold my hand？
All right. ...Like this？
Th-thank... kyaaa!!
Whoaaaa!!
This part where it climbs before the drop is nerve-racking, huh.
Anegasaki
Yeah. Don't you kind of regret it？
Actually, a little.
Ah, ahaha... me too.
Eeek！
Anegasaki
Wow... Beautiful... This is like a dream...
What would you do if it really were a dream？
The parade？
Everything. Being with me too...
Then... I'd want to never wake up...
Anegasaki
When I was little, I once tried to copy this.
The parade？ How？
I wrapped Christmas tree lights all over myself. It was sparkly and pretty.
That's dangerous. You can't do something like that.
Yeah. I got in so much trouble. Don't copy me, okay？
Anegasaki
I... always wanted to ride on that. It was my dream when I was little.
Huh... then when I get my license, do you want a car like that？
Covered in lots of sparkly lights？
Yeah. Super sparkly.
Are you going to be a trucker？
Huh...？ Oh, there are trucks like that.
Hehe. A normal car is fine, I think？ As long as I'm the only one in the passenger seat... okay？
Wow...
Anegasaki
Eh？ What？ What is it？
No... I just thought ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a swimsuit looks amazing too...
Hehe. Falling for me all over again？
More like I never stopped falling？
Geez... That's my line, you know？
Anegasaki
Pools are nice because you can have fun even if you can't swim.
Don't you want to learn to swim？
Well, you can live without swimming, right？
Well, that's true...
Right. You can live without swimming. So it's fine.
You don't have to be so adamant...
Anegasaki
Indoor pools are nice since you don't have to worry about sunburn.
I don't think that's true. Quite a lot of light comes through the skylight.
Huh, really？ Aww, I don't want tan lines from my swimsuit.
Oh, I see.
Hehe. Could it be... you want to see them？
Eh!?
Geez, don't take it seriously. Bad boy.
Anegasaki
Pretty...
Yeah. You can't see anything like this in town anymore, though.
I wonder if you can still see it in the mountains...
Let's go see it someday. A sky full of stars.
Yeah... take me.
Anegasaki
Say... Is it okay to hold hands？
Sure... but what's up？
Hehe. It feels like this is real space, and I might get sucked in... weird, huh？
Even in real space, I'd never let go.
Yeah... Never let go.
Anegasaki
Hey...
What...？
Are you there？
Yeah. I'm here.
I see...
I'll always be by your side...
Yeah...
Anegasaki
Wow, so warm.
It's the subtropical plant section... but it is a bit hot.
Hehe. It's summer in here all year long, huh？
Otherwise they'd wither, I guess？
Then is it summer break in here forever？
Summer break is locked up in here... hehe, botanical gardens are interesting places.
Anegasaki
The air feels nice. Is it because there's more oxygen？
It smells different in here as well.
Ah, you're right... nice smell... which flower is it？
Hmm... I wonder which one.
Want to look for it？
Sure. Then, one at a time.
Hehe. We're like butterflies, drawn in by the scent of flowers.
Anegasaki
It'd be nice if humans could photosynthesize like plants.
Like plants？
Then we'd be fine with just light, water... and soil, right？ Wouldn't the world be so peaceful？
But your skin would be green, you know？
Ugh... I wouldn't like that. Yeah. Humans should be humans after all.
Anegasaki
Ah, it was fun.
Yeah. So satisfied. I really enjoyed it.
Let's come again.
Together again.
Yes, together. Hehe.
Anegasaki
I meant to just watch casually, but I got really into it, huh.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too？
But I'm a bit tired. Hey, give me a piggyback.
That's a little...
Geez！ Some man you are, how pathetic.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how was it？
Anegasaki
Hmm... everyone has different tastes, you know.
Could it be you were bored？
Yeah, actually, really bored.
Oh, I see. Sorry.
Hehe, take me somewhere better next time, okay？
Anegasaki
Did you know？ They say if a couple crosses this bridge holding hands all the way, they'll be happy.
Really？
Kidding.
Hehe. But if it were true, what would you do？
Of course, I'd cross it with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Then... we'd be the very first couple？ Hehe. That'd be nice too.
Anegasaki
No matter how many times I see it... it's amazing...
You mean the bridge？
Yes. Humans can build something this huge...
What's wrong？
I was entranced by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ being entranced by the bridge.
Geez...
Anegasaki
Ah, the wind's too strong.
With wind this strong, you might get blown away？
Geez. I'm not a little kid, I won't get blown away.
Ahaha, that's true.
Opening an umbrella every typhoon and going "Parachute！" was only when I was little.
(That's unexpected too...)
Anegasaki
The sun's so strong... is this what they call piercing heat？
Yeah. You could get tanned in a single day.
When I get sunburned, the skin on the tip of my nose peels.
Huh. That might be kind of cute. I want to see it.
No way. It's embarrassing, like a little boy.
Anegasaki
...Hah.
What's wrong？ Why are you sighing all of a sudden？
No, I'm just scared of what comes after.
Of what？
Because just coming to the beach with you like this, I'm already happy, you know？
Maybe I should've brought sunglasses？
Anegasaki
The sun's strong, huh. But a high schooler in sunglasses looks a bit like a delinquent, maybe？
Sunglasses would suit ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I bet.
Eh？ Really？ Wouldn't I look like a bad girl？
No. You're beautiful, so you'd look like an idol on her day off.
Ah... geez. Flattery won't get you anything.
Of course there's no one here.
Anegasaki
But isn't it lovely being completely alone together？ Let's stay like this a while？
...I think I'm going to catch a cold.
Geez, and I was trying to set the mood！
...But it really is cold. Let's head home early.
Anegasaki
In summer you can swim, but... there's nothing now, of course.
Yeah. There aren't many people either...
Hehe. The sea outside of summer is actually a hidden date spot.
Is that so？
So... since we're here, want to walk on the beach with big sis？
The sea is cold when it's not summer, huh.
Anegasaki
Really？ Not that cold. Want to try swimming a bit？
But we didn't bring anything...
Who cares？ In our birthday suits. It's just the two of us.
...N-naked？
Hehe. Just kidding. ...Your face is all red. You're so cute, geez.
Sunfish sure are big...
Anegasaki
Because they live in the sea... maybe？
Is that why？
Hmm, I don't really know... but you know, goldfish get bigger if you keep them in a pond, right？
Huh, really.
So I bet if you kept a sunfish in a goldfish bowl, it'd stay small... maybe？ Yes, it would. Definitely.
(I really don't think so...)
Anegasaki
Don't sunfish make you sleepy, watching them？
Are you sleepy？
No. But they're so laid-back, I feel like I'd get sleepy if I watched them long enough.
Ah. I can see that.
I see... when I go to bed, instead of counting sheep, I should count sunfish.
One sunfish, two sunfish... huh？ Is the plural of sunfish just "sunfish"？
Anegasaki
Ah, penguins. So cute！
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you like cute things, huh.
Is there a girl who doesn't？
Come to think of it, true...
But what if I'm the only girl who likes you... how would you feel about that？
That's plenty for me.
Hehe. Then I'll love you lots and lots, to make up for all the other girls.
Anegasaki
Seeing them like this, penguins are surprisingly big, huh.
Did you picture them smaller, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah. More like... small enough to sit in your hand？
A palm-sized penguin？
Ah, that'd be cute too. Hehe. Flapping its little wings in your hand.
Flap, flap.
Ahaha. You're cute, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Huh？ Ah... geez, don't tease me.
Anegasaki
Wow～, amazing. So pretty...
It really feels like a walk under the sea.
Yeah, it's like we are under the sea.
It's another world...
No. There are just things in the world we don't know yet. I bet there are still lots and lots.
I see... yeah, that's true.
Hehe. I can't wait. The two of us, seeing lots of worlds we don't know, together.
Anegasaki
I wish this tunnel went on way, way longer.
You like it, huh.
Yes. I'd like to live here.
Get a job here in the future？
Working and living are different. Ah... but for a housewife, they're the same... hmm, they're the same, huh.
...That's what you're stuck on？
Anegasaki
Aww, dolphins are so cute. I want to ride one.
There are aquariums that let you ride them, I think？ Not this one, though.
Really？ Aww, take me someday.
You'd ride one？ But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you can't swi...
Boo boo.
They say dolphins are as smart as dogs. They really are clever.
Anegasaki
Yes. But which dog, though？ Dogs vary in smartness too, right？
Um... how smart, I wonder？
About a dachshund？
Really？
They kind of look alike, I think. Hehe. Shall we look it up together later？
(Look alike... how？)
Anegasaki
Wow, nice view. Ah, you can see the bay bridge.
Huh, a ship's coming right now... picture-perfect.
My dream used to be to travel alone on a big ship for months someday.
"Used to be"？ Past tense？
Yes, past tense. My dream now... isn't traveling alone.
Anegasaki
I can smell the sea...
Yeah. The sea breeze reaches all the way here.
I like the sea. It's a bit scary at night, but I love that too.
Yeah. I think the sea suits ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Really？ Hehe... ah, a big ship. I'd love to ride one someday...
Mmm, this feels nice.
Anegasaki
Yeah. It feels so nice I'm getting kind of sleepy.
At this hour!?
Mm... last night, I just...
...Ah. Are you the type who can't sleep the night before a field trip？
Huh, ah... that's not it...
Anegasaki
Wow. What a view.
It's nearly 50 meters tall, after all. The observation deck's a bit lower.
Yeah. Still plenty. It's high.
Ah, you can see all the way to the park on the far shore. And on this side is the stadium... right？
Wow. You know a lot. Impressive, impressive.
Actually, I studied up beforehand.
Ah, I see... hehe, good boy, good boy.
I wonder if they sell those thermometer souvenirs here too.
Anegasaki
What's that？
Little figurines of the tower with a thermometer attached.
Ah, I know those. There are similar ones at all kinds of towers, right？
I wonder if I can also find them here.
Hehe. It's local, so I never paid attention... let's look.
Anegasaki
Aha, we're here. Actually, I'm not good with elevators. Especially going down.
Huh？ Why？
Yeah. I feel like I'm going to get sucked into the depths of the earth...
And at the bottom, mole people are waiting？
Ah... I see. If I think of it that way, it's not scary at all.
Anegasaki
Ah, this is nice. Oh, this one's cute too. Mmm, I can't decide.
Don't worry about me, take your time.
Okay, thanks. Eek, they have this too. So nice.
She really is a girl, huh.
Eh？ What？
Nothing. Just talking to myself.
Sorry, I just can't help it... ah, this was hiding here. It'd be cute with this one.
I'm fine. Fashion's not really my thing.
Anegasaki
No, that won't do. These days, boys care about that kind of thing too.
But, um... hey, wait a sec？
Ah, wouldn't this suit you？ Ah, this one's nice too. Try it on for a sec.
Like I said, for me...
Come on, hurry. Ah, this one's nice too. Here, change.
(I'm totally overwhelmed...)
I thought ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ didn't wear makeup.
Anegasaki
Yes, mostly I don't. Just some toner after a bath, maybe？
For your skin？
Yes, well, that. All sorts of things.
I see. Girls have it tough, huh.
Hehe. We have to go through so many hardships that guys could never imagine.
Anegasaki
Once I'm out in the working world, I guess I'll have to wear at least a little makeup.
Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ hardly wears makeup, huh.
Hehe. Would you like to see me with makeup on？
Yeah. I want to see more sides of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I see... yes, then maybe I'll give it some thought？
Accessories, huh... maybe I'll buy something too.
Anegasaki
Like a bracelet？
A ring. Silver, maybe. Nothing too flashy.
They say silver wards off evil. Maybe I want one too？
Then, are you interested in matching rings？
Yes, yes. Yes, I am.
Ehe, I'll nod as hard as I can.
This kind of thing would suit ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I bet.
Anegasaki
Which？ Ah, cute... aww, but no. They're for pierced ears.
Ah, you don't have pierced ears.
Right. Putting a hole in your ear is kind of scary, isn't it？
Even though you're fine with horror？
That's different. But they're so cute. Mmm, I'm so torn.
It's so quiet, it's almost scary.
Anegasaki
Yes. But it's full of life... so it's quiet, but a gentle kind of quiet, I guess？
Are we disturbing it, maybe？
Ah... true. We should be quiet. Shhh～～.
Shhh～～.
Anegasaki
Ah, did you see it？ Did you see that？
Yeah, a fish jumped.
What was it... an ayu, maybe？
I can't really tell.
The stand earlier was selling grilled ayu on skewers, so it must be an ayu.
(That doesn't necessarily follow...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay with bikes？
Anegasaki
Huh？ I can ride one just fine... do I look that clumsy？
Not that. Look, over there. Rental bikes.
Ah... hehe. I wonder if they have bikes for two？
I bet they do. Want to go see？
Okay.
Anegasaki
Aha, this feels nice. Like a boat trip.
On the sea it rocks a lot more, though.
Really？
Yeah. Then next time, want to go somewhere by boat？
Hehe. I'm saving that kind of thing for our honeymoon. So... okay？
Ah, look. The people at the campsite are waving... hey there！
Anegasaki
Geez... no.
Why？
Because... it's all girls over there...
Sorry. Then... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Hey there.
...Hehe. Yes～.
Anegasaki
Ah, a bird. Pretty. What kind of bird is it？
Hmm... the only birds I know are pigeons, sparrows, ostriches... and chickens, maybe.
Hehe. And penguins.
If I'd brought a camera, we could look it up later... a phone won't cut it, huh？
No, it's fine. Just thinking "how pretty, I wonder what it is" is fun enough.
Hup... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you okay？
Anegasaki
Yeah, I'm fine. Haah, you really are a boy, huh.
Here, give me your hand. Hup.
Phew. Thanks. ...Sorry I'm so slow.
No, I should walk a bit slower.
It's fine. I'll try. All right, let's go.
Anegasaki
Wow, amazing. What a view.
Do you like it？
Yes！ Thanks for taking me up here.
You're welcome. Let's take a little break, then.
Yeah, actually I was tired. I'm glad you noticed.
Apparently when you walk long distances, it's better not to lift your knees much.
Anegasaki
Really？ Um, like this？
Right. Keep your soles parallel to the ground, like gliding through the air.
Ah, really. It's a little easier. Huh.
Think you can walk a bit more？
Yes, I'm fine. But... ehe, I'd like you to hold my hand... maybe.
Anegasaki
So beautiful. The whole mountain now looks like a sunset.
They've turned such beautiful colors...
At times like this, I'm glad I was born in Japan.
Cherry blossoms in spring, autumn leaves in fall...
Hehe. You're a poet today. Because it's autumn, maybe？
Anegasaki
Are those momiji？ They've turned such a pretty red.
You're right. They really turn a pretty red...
Is that why momiji tempura tastes good, I wonder？
I don't think that's related.
Hehe. Doesn't talking like this make you hungry？
Anegasaki
I'm glad the weather's nice. The snow's a bit dazzling, though.
Ski wear suits ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ too, as expected.
Really？ Like an idol on a private ski trip？
Yes, something like that.
Geez... keep up the obvious flattery and I'll bury you in the snow, okay？
Then shall we take the lift？
Anegasaki
Ah, yeah...
Huh？ Were you scared of heights？
No, I'm fine with heights, but high-up rides I'm a little bad with.
I see. I'm sorry for not noticing that.
No. If I'm with you, it's not that scary. So... I can hold your hand, right？
Anegasaki
Heh heh. I win～.
Ugh, I lost... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're good.
Hehe. My older cousin taught me in elementary school.
Hmm, an older cousin, huh.
Hehe, are you jealous？
Not really...
He's an uncle past forty now. And married... Want to go down once more？ Together this time, okay？
...Hmm.
Anegasaki
Interested in this kind of thing？
No, more like... what even is this？
Abstract art is something you feel, so I think however you feel right now is fine？
So that's how it is.
Hehe. Tell me later, slowly. How it made you feel.
Whoa. This portrait's looking at me no matter where I stand...
Anegasaki
It's like its eyes follow you.
Yeah. It's watching.
We're looking at the portrait, and the portrait's looking at us.
I see... deep.
Anegasaki
Somehow, I feel like drawing again...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you can draw？
No, I've just liked it since I was little. It's not like I'm good at it, okay？
I'd like to see.
Like I said, I don't draw right now. Geez...
Anegasaki
Ah, a giraffe parent and baby... so cute. Kids really are cute.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, do you like kids, maybe？
Yes, I do. When you play with them, they have so much fun. They're really cute, you know？
I see... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would make a great mom, I bet.
Hehe. And who'd be the dad then, I wonder？
Well...
Ufufu.
Anegasaki
Apparently giraffes don't just have long necks, they have good eyesight too.
So they can see really far.
Right. They're like an observation deck themselves.
I can't imagine something like that...
Hehe. They say kids and adults see totally different worlds, right？ What's a giraffe's world like, I wonder？
I bet... it's a world we'll never know in our whole lives.
It's sleeping.
Anegasaki
Yeah, it's sleeping.
But it's the king of beasts...
Since it's the king, it can lounge around sleeping, can't it？
Can't be helped. It's the emperor with no clothes.
Hehe. You think you just said something clever, don't you？
Anegasaki
To think about it, the lion is just a giant cat.
They're in the cat family, technically.
How small would it have to get to be cute？ About cat-sized？
Hmm, or the other way around, how big would a cat have to get before it stopped being cute？
The cats back in my family's hometown are about 60 centimeters, but they're cute, you know？
60 centimeters!? That's past the level of cute...
But they're cute...
Huh, lots of small animals running around loose.
Anegasaki
Hah...
Ah, what's wrong？
Because there are bunnies... ah, and that pony is so cuuute～.
Oh right, you love cute things, don't you.
Yes, I love them. I love them so much I could just melt... haah...
Anegasaki
Whoa！ Whoa！ What do I do, they're all gathering around me！
Huh. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you must be the type animals like.
Aww, what do I do？ I only have throat lozenges...
You can't. Feeding them is prohibited.
Oh. Sorry, everyone...
Even if it weren't prohibited, I don't think they'd eat throat lozenges...
Clerk
Welcome.
Anegasaki
Hehe, you want to pick your girlfriend's swimsuit.
It's not like that...
I'll take requests, you know？
Then...
Only a bikini will do
